moments.title: Premier League Action Continues
moments.blurb: The Premier League season is in full swing with multiple fixtures scheduled from today through early September, including key matches across the UK.

source.l: Premier League Official Site / The Guardian

angles.name: Today's Games
angles.copy: Kick-off! Today's Premier League schedule sees Chelsea face Luton Town, Manchester United host Nottingham Forest, and Newcastle United take on Liverpool. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Weekend Preview
angles.copy: The Premier League weekend is almost here! Sunday brings us Chelsea vs Brighton & Hove Albion and Manchester United vs Ipswich Town. Predictions?

angles.name: Midweek Clash
angles.copy: Don't miss the midweek Premier League action! Crystal Palace meet Manchester City this Friday. Big points on the line!

moments.title: England vs Pakistan Test at Lord's
moments.blurb: England's men's cricket team continues their three-Test series against Pakistan, with the second Test starting tomorrow, August 27th, at Lord's.

angles.name: Lord's Battle
angles.copy: The home of cricket hosts another thrilling Test match! England take on Pakistan at Lord's from tomorrow. Will England dominate or can Pakistan bounce back?

angles.name: Test Series Update
angles.copy: The second Test of the England vs Pakistan series begins tomorrow. After Headingley, all eyes are on Lord's for what promises to be a gripping contest.

moments.title: Fury vs Joshua Fight Talk
moments.blurb: Promoter Frank Warren predicts the highly anticipated Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua heavyweight showdown will happen in 2026, despite recent location disputes.

angles.name: Heavyweight Hype
angles.copy: It's the fight everyone wants to see! Frank Warren is confident Fury vs Joshua will happen in 2026. Will it be UK soil or across the Atlantic?

angles.name: Fight Location Debate
angles.copy: Fury vs Joshua: London or America? The debate rages on for the biggest fight in British boxing. Where do you think it should be?

moments.title: PM Eyes UK World Cup Bid for 2042
moments.blurb: Prime Minister Andy Burnham has expressed his ambition for the UK to host the men's FIFA World Cup in 2042, with informal discussions already underway.

angles.name: World Cup Dreams
angles.copy: Could the World Cup be coming back to Britain? PM Andy Burnham wants to bid for the 2042 tournament. Imagine the atmosphere!

angles.name: Future Football
angles.copy: Discussions are starting about a potential UK bid for the 2042 FIFA World Cup. Time to start planning those fan zones!

moments.title: Ariana Grande's UK Tour
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande's highly anticipated first tour in seven years is currently underway in the UK and Ireland, running until September 1st.

angles.name: Sweetener Tour Buzz
angles.copy: The UK is buzzing! Ariana Grande's first tour in 7 years is here and it's everything Arianators dreamed of. Catch her before Sep 1st!

angles.name: Pop Sensation Live
angles.copy: Ariana Grande is bringing her incredible vocals and stage presence to the UK! If you've got tickets, you're in for a treat.

moments.title: Bon Jovi 'Forever' UK Tour
moments.blurb: Rock legends Bon Jovi kick off their 'Forever' UK and Ireland tour this Friday, August 28th, running until September 9th.

angles.name: Rock Icons Return
angles.copy: Get ready to sing along! Bon Jovi's 'Forever' tour starts this Friday. Which classic track are you most excited to hear live?

angles.name: Living on a Prayer
angles.copy: Bon Jovi are back! Their UK tour kicks off in just two days. It's going to be a massive celebration of their legendary career.

moments.title: Jay-Z's One-Night London Show
moments.blurb: Rap mogul Jay-Z is set to play a special one-night-only stadium show at London's Tottenham Hotspur Stadium on September 4th.

angles.name: Hov in London
angles.copy: London, get ready! Jay-Z is hitting Tottenham Hotspur Stadium for one night only on September 4th. This is going to be epic.

angles.name: Rap Royalty
angles.copy: Celebrating 30 years in the game, Jay-Z brings his iconic sound to London for a special stadium performance next week. Who's got tickets?

moments.title: BBC Proms Continues at Royal Albert Hall
moments.blurb: The BBC Proms continue this week at the Royal Albert Hall with a series of classical concerts, including The Met Orchestra performing Strauss tonight.

angles.name: Proms Evening
angles.copy: Tonight at the BBC Proms: The Met Orchestra takes on Strauss. A perfect evening of classical brilliance at the Royal Albert Hall.

angles.name: Classical Gems
angles.copy: From Mahler to Beethoven, the BBC Proms offers a stunning lineup of classical music this week. Immerse yourself in the magic of live orchestra.

moments.title: Happy 60th to Shirley Manson
moments.blurb: Scottish rock icon Shirley Manson, lead singer of Garbage, celebrates her 60th birthday today, August 26th.

angles.name: Garbage Frontwoman
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 60th birthday to the incredible Shirley Manson! The voice of Garbage, still pushing boundaries.

angles.name: Scottish Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 60th to Edinburgh's own rock queen, Shirley Manson! From Angelfish to Garbage, a true music legend.

moments.title: Happy 66th to Branford Marsalis
moments.blurb: Renowned American jazz saxophonist Branford Marsalis celebrates his 66th birthday today, August 26th.

angles.name: Jazz Legend
angles.copy: Happy 66th to the phenomenal Branford Marsalis! A true jazz virtuoso and a master of the saxophone.

angles.name: Musical Royalty
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy birthday to the incredible Branford Marsalis. His contributions to jazz and beyond are immeasurable.

moments.title: Happy 29th to Mae Muller
moments.blurb: British pop singer and Eurovision star Mae Muller celebrates her 29th birthday today, August 26th.

angles.name: Pop Star Birthday
angles.copy: Sending big birthday wishes to the brilliant Mae Muller, turning 29 today! What's your favourite track from her?

angles.name: Eurovision Fave
angles.copy: Happy 29th birthday to our very own Mae Muller! From chart hits to Eurovision, she keeps the bops coming.

moments.title: Remembering Michael Jackson
moments.blurb: The King of Pop, Michael Jackson, would have celebrated his 68th birthday this Saturday, August 29th.

angles.name: King of Pop
angles.copy: This Saturday, we remember the legendary Michael Jackson, who would have turned 68. His music truly changed the world.

angles.name: Forever Iconic
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of Michael Jackson, who would have been 68 on August 29th. What's your all-time favourite MJ track?

moments.title: Happy 45th to Beyoncé
moments.blurb: Global superstar Beyoncé, the iconic singer, celebrates her 45th birthday next week on September 4th.

angles.name: Queen Bey's Birthday
angles.copy: All hail Queen Bey! Beyoncé turns 45 next week on September 4th. Get ready to celebrate the one and only!

angles.name: Iconic at 45
angles.copy: From Destiny's Child to global domination, Beyoncé continues to inspire. Wishing her a fabulous 45th next week!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Hold #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at number one on the Official UK Singles Chart for an impressive 22nd week.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still reigning! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is #1 for a massive 22nd week. Is it your favourite track right now?

angles.name: Longest Run
angles.copy: 22 weeks at number one! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are making history with 'Rein Me In'. What a monumental achievement!

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Launch Nears
moments.blurb: Anticipation is building for the new series of Strictly Come Dancing, with the pre-recorded launch show airing on September 19th and live shows starting September 26th.

angles.name: Glitterball Countdown
angles.copy: Dust off your dancing shoes! Strictly Come Dancing is just weeks away, with the launch show on Sep 19th. Who are you excited to see hit the ballroom?

angles.name: New Hosts & Judges
angles.copy: The new era of Strictly is almost here! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe take the reins. Get ready for the glitz and glamour!

moments.title: Nigella Lawson Joins Bake Off
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off returns on September 29th with a major shake-up, as culinary icon Nigella Lawson joins Paul Hollywood as a new judge.

angles.name: New Bake Off Era
angles.copy: Big news for Bake Off fans! Nigella Lawson is joining the tent as a new judge this September 29th. What do you make of the new lineup?

angles.name: Baking is Back
angles.copy: Get ready for soggy bottoms and Hollywood handshakes! The Great British Bake Off returns next month with Nigella Lawson adding her sparkle.

moments.title: New TV Tonight: The Murder Detectives
moments.blurb: Tonight, Channel 4 premieres a new factual series, 'The Murder Detectives' at 9pm, offering a deep dive into real-life investigations.

angles.name: True Crime Tonight
angles.copy: For true crime fans: 'The Murder Detectives' starts tonight at 9pm on Channel 4. Prepare for a gripping new series.

angles.name: Wednesday Night Watch
angles.copy: What are you watching tonight? Catch the new drama 'Bookish' on U&Alibi at 8pm, or 'Professor T' on ITV1 at 9pm!

moments.title: Summer Bank Holiday Approaching
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31st, marking a long weekend for many.

angles.name: Long Weekend Vibes
angles.copy: That's right, a long weekend is just around the corner! The Summer Bank Holiday is this Monday, August 31st. How are you spending it?

angles.name: End of Summer Break
angles.copy: Make the most of it! The last bank holiday of summer is almost here. Perfect for a final getaway or some local fun.
